title: ranunculus aquatilis subsp. baudotii
intro: Ranunculus aquatilis subsp. baudotii, commonly known as Yellow Water Crowfoot, is a submerged aquatic plant that belongs to the family Ranunculaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. Its therapeutic actions include exhibiting antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential treatment for various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Ranunculus aquatilis subsp. baudotii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
